title: calendar-list v1 (blob)
description: The calendars of a connection's account at the provider, as the connectors module read them when a member granted calendar access. A blob (`application/vnd.campbooks.calendar-list+json; version=1`) that `connectors.capability_granted` v1 points at for the `calendar` capability; the schedule module creates one calendar per entry. The provider's calendar id can be an address, so it travels here and never in an event. Deleted with the workspace.

provider.description: Whose calendars they are (optional): the schedule module names it in the event sheet.

provider_id.description: The calendar's id at the provider.

primary.description: The account's primary calendar: the one that syncs at first.

writable.description: Whether events may be created and changed on it.

owned.description: Whether the account owns the calendar (Google accessRole owner, Zoho privilege owner); absent when the provider does not say.
